srList.sentence: Study selection The PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane Library databases were queried for all relevant studies published as of September 2020 using the following search strategy: (((transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shuntTitleAbstract) OR (TIPSTitleAbstract)) AND ((8 mmTitleAbstract) OR (small diameterTitleAbstract))) AND ((10 mmTitleAbstract) OR (large diameterTitleAbstract)).

srList.sentence: Studies were eligible for inclusion if they were: (a) randomized controlled trials (RCTs) or non-randomized comparative studies assessing TIPS outcomes associated with 8 mm and 10 mm stents (b) patients with cirrhosis portal hypertension and (c) reported DPPG, postoperative HE rates, TIPS dysfunction rates, re-bleeding rates, rates of liver transplantation, andor mortality rates associated with these procedures.
